questions.q: Figure X is the opposite of figure Y. Which figure is the opposite of figure G? / Rajah X ialah songsangan bagi rajah Y. Rajah manakah songsangan bagi rajah G?

There are three songs on a CD. The first is 6 minutes 25 seconds long, the second is 12 minutes 25 seconds and the third is 10 minutes 13 seconds. How long are all three songs together? / Terdapat tiga lagu dalam sebuah CD. Lagu pertama 6 minit 25 saat, lagu kedua 12 minit 25 saat dan lagu ketiga 10 minit 13 saat. Berapakah jumlah durasi ketiga-tiga lagu itu?

Which number must go in the first cloud to make all the calculations correct?  ?  → −2 →  ☐  → ÷3 →  ☐  → +4 →  5 / Nombor apakah yang perlu dimasukkan dalam awan pertama supaya semua pengiraan betul?  ?  → −2 →  ☐  → ÷3 →  ☐  → +4 →  5

Ali has a 60 cm ruler. Some of the markings have faded. He can measure any of the lengths 10, 20, 30, 40, 50 and 60 cm using his ruler only once. Which marks are still on Ali's ruler? / Ali mempunyai pembaris 60 cm. Beberapa tanda ukur telah pudar. Dia boleh mengukur mana-mana panjang 10, 20, 30, 40, 50 dan 60 cm dengan menggunakan pembarisnya sekali sahaja. Tanda manakah yang masih ada pada pembaris Ali?

There are 8 cars waiting for a ferry. Every car contains either 2 or 3 people. In total there are 19 people. How many cars contain exactly 2 people? / Terdapat 8 buah kereta menunggu feri. Setiap kereta membawa sama ada 2 atau 3 orang. Jumlahnya 19 orang. Berapakah bilangan kereta yang membawa tepat 2 orang?

Rebecca folds a square piece of paper twice. Then she cuts off one corner. Next, she unfolds the paper. What does the paper look like once it is unfolded? / Rebecca melipat sekeping kertas segi empat sama dua kali. Kemudian dia memotong satu bucu. Seterusnya dia membuka lipatan kertas itu. Apakah rupa kertas itu selepas dibuka?

Hermione, Harry and Ron always walk into the common room one at a time. Hermione is never first, Harry is never second and Ron is never third. In how many different orders could they walk in? / Hermione, Harry dan Ron sentiasa masuk ke bilik rehat seorang demi seorang. Hermione tidak pernah pertama, Harry tidak pernah kedua dan Ron tidak pernah ketiga. Berapakah bilangan turutan berbeza mereka masuk?
